verdict.rationale: Parsec documents a Teams API for automating deployment, plus API access for automation, reporting and full audit logs. That is a real first-party programmatic surface, but it appears scoped to Teams/Enterprise administration rather than driving the core remote-desktop product. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and machine-readable API docs at guessed paths returned 404, which leaves depth unproven but does not contradict the API's existence. missing for 10: evidence of public API reference documentation, an API covering core session/connection control rather than only deployment and admin, availability beyond the Teams/Enterprise tier, and a machine-readable spec or independent corroboration of the API in use.
